messages:
liz: Heads-up — BigRetail asking for a pinned model v1.8. Customer audit next month, wants freeze until migration finished. can we triage? :eyes:

sam: What's the ask exactly? full pin for 60d or exception for traffic routing?

liz: They want guaranteed behavior (no drift), so full pin on production route. Willing to pay for reserved capacity. They also want rollback path.

priya: Technical note: v1.8 uses a custom tokenizer we don't ship in the open catalog. Pinning is doable but requires a compat shim for v2.0; migration risk = eval delta ~4-6% on our QA embedding set.

jordan: infra checklist: pin means we reserve a dedicated model artifact + patch for KV cache persistence. Storage + ops delta ~0.6 GPUs/month; need SLA on updates.

mike: Can we propose a "soft-pin" instead? Route 100% to v1.8 but allow automatic fallback to v2 if latency/cost SLOs breach. Gives safety and avoids permanent commit.

anika: Legal: audit clause ok but need explicit termination and data-handling terms. Also require 30d notice before deprecation regardless of pin.

sam: Proposed path: 1) Offer paid 90-day pin with canary (2% traffic) for 7 days; 2) run benchmark suite + 3 target prompts; 3) lock pin with SLA only if no regressions.

priya: Benchmarks we require: latency p95 < 350ms, output-similarity >= 92% vs baseline on our eval prompts, and regression <1% in hallucination metric. I'll attach eval matrix.

liz: That sounds reasonable. BigRetail wants immediate start. If we agree, we should scope engineer time and price. @jordan can you give a rough ops cost estimate?

jordan: Ops: ~0.6 GPU/mo + 8h initial setup + 4h/wk monitoring for the pin period. Estimate $7k/mo infra ops. I'll open infra ticket.

mike: Action: I can own the canary automation and fallback policy. Will push a config like:

`````
route: bigretail-prod
pin: v1.8
canary: 2%
fallback: v2.0 on cost/latency breach
metrics: [p95_latency, output_sim]
`````

liz: please add an alert for model-drift > 3% so we can notify.

sam: Decision check: product ok with paid pin + canary + eval gates? react with :thumbsup: if yes.

priya: :thumbsup: also recommend adding a "migration playbook" doc for the customer.

anika: :thumbsup:

jordan: opening infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3345

mike: opening eng ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7788

liz: I'll send BigRetail the cadence and pricing. Leaving the pin in icebox if legal needs edits, but aiming to start canary on Mon. Thanks all :sparkles:

ops-bot: canary-deploy scheduled for 1716639600 by mike
